notes.title: METAL SUITS, We need your help!
notes.content:
Hi all! 
The never-ending hot summer is over and fall has come in South Korea. I am writing the 18th devlog while welcoming the cool breeze.
I started the article with the title "We need your help", but today I would like to talk about the official version of METAL SUITS and the Steam demo version. And [b]we really need your help!![/b]

==============================

[b][h2]1. Story about the official version of METAL SUITS[/h2][/b]
METAL SUITS Project began development in May 2022. Since then, development has been done in parallel with other projects, so if you exclude that schedule, the development period has taken approximately 25 months until August 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/645de1ab77415ffd2516f46381d4f9b67fef7d29.png[/img]
<METAL SUITS Early Version Main Title Image>

As of the end of August 2024, the PC version of the game has been completed, and starting in September, optimization work and porting for the console devices release are in progress.

There are three difficulty levels (Normal, Hard, Hell), and in the case of Normal difficulty, it took about 15 hours to clear the stage. If you enjoy other content such as hidden elements and additional stages, it seems that you will need about 18 hours of play.

Personally, I think the "Hell" difficulty is difficult, but it is incredibly fun, so I recommend you enjoy the "Hell" difficulty when the official version comes out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/63c4c5e9c77e31e2b7c5619c50408428c76d6d9e.png[/img]
<METAL SUITS current version main title image>

[b][h2]2. Story about the Steam Demo version[/h2][/b]
The METAL SUITS demo version was officially(?) released in May 2024. A few days later, we were contacted by the producer of the Future Games Show to introduce our game on their show, and it was exhibited in early June.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/eca9c3317cdcfd8abab055e79fec939c821fc9c9.gif[/img]
<METAL SUITS featured at the Future Games Show>

[h2]>>>>> [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bodrBCQK37g&t=89s]Go to the 2024 Future Games Show Ones To Play video[/url][/h2]

And, in June 2024, it was selected as one of 22 featured games by Steam at the Steam Next Fest and was featured in a Steam promotional video.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/f1f9be94ba96be0db736da15cceffdca8b5b3a3e.png[/img]
<METAL SUITS was Included in the Official 2024 Steam Next Fest June Video>

[h2]>>>>> [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y_IE5ToRwNo&t=16s]Go to Steam Recommended Videos[/url][/h2]

By the way, did you know? We created new stages for the METAL SUITS demo version that are different from the official version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/4560de70fcc1aba5e4effd6892219a98eb8d38e3.png[/img]
<Guide to the demo version stage configuration on the Steam store>

Nevertheless, after playing the METAL SUITS, many people left reviews on the discussion board saying that it is really fun. Unfortunately, Steam does not provide a review feature for the demo version, which is why this happened. (I think most users don't know that reviews have been left on the discussion board!!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/7622a650f2fb08f0bc9e08604a829ccc0c023215.png[/img]
<METAL SUITS Steam Discussion section Reviews>

But finally in September 2024!!! Steam has updated the feature to allow you to leave reviews for the demo version. Now, if you have played the Metal Suit demo on Steam, you can leave a review like the image below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/e21344d308b1a8eb4e4870a1b16cbdcefd0a6e74.png[/img]
<Steam added review feature for demo version>

[b][h2]So, we would like to ask everyone who played our game, if you enjoyed the METAL SUITS demo, please leave a review! We would really appreciate it.

>>>>> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959450/METAL_SUITS_Counterattack_Demo/]Go to the METAL SUITS Steam Demo page[/url][/h2][/b]

---

Thanks for reading to the end, and if you're interested in our project, please like and follow us on the Steam link below.

Steam Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2093800/

P.S. - Don't forget to go to the Steam demo page and leave a review!

notes.title: METAL SUITS, Steam demo release and other news
notes.content:
Hi, folks! This is my seventeenth devlog. We released the demo at the beginning of May, so I missed the timing of writing the devlog that was supposed to be written at the end of April ^^;;
I’ve only left the last planet description, but I’m hoping you’ll enjoy it in the full version game, so I’ll keep the last planet explanation out of the devlog!

==============================

[b][h2]1. Steam Demo released[/h2][/b]
On the morning of May 7th (KST), the Steam demo of “METAL SUITS” was released. With the Steam demo, we also released a demo launch video with a story.

DEMO Download : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2093800/

[previewyoutube=uAWjsii8PeQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The released demo currently supports English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
(*More languages will be supported in the full version!!)

[b][h2]2. Participating in local events[/h2][/b]
“METAL SUITS”, which is in production, participated in the “19th Gyeonggi Game Audition” and “IndieCraft 2024” held in Korea.


[b](1) 19th Gyeonggi Game Audition[/b]

The Gyeonggi Game Audition, which started in 2015, has just completed its 19th edition. About 230 companies participated in the 19th Gyeonggi Game Audition, and the final presentation evaluation was held on May 24, 2024, and was evaluated by about 20 expert evaluators and about 100 audience evaluators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/3ac9031dca8bb1aad3d74f5e796f0c8d86a27ced.jpg[/img]

“METAL SUITS” also participated in the 19th Gyeonggi Game Audition event and was selected in the TOP10 and won the 1st place winner at the final presentation!!!


[b](2) IndieCraft 2024[/b]

IndieCraft, which started in 2017, is now in its eighth year. This year, 326 Korean companies participated, making it the largest number of games ever submitted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/8322bc7995e902a5bf67e2b5467af72fa9ef8135.png[/img]

We participated in the IndieCraft 2024 event with our “METAL SUITS” and were selected in the TOP 15 out of 326 companies, and won 2nd place winner at the final presentation!!!


[h2][b]3. Participating in international events[/b][/h2]

[b](1) Participated Steam Next Fest June 2024[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/3c5dd1bf2ea230e2fd7eb679866eb8ed563b93bc.png[/img]

METAL SUITS has completed participation in the June Steam Next Fest from June 11th.


[b](2) Participated Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2024
[/b]
We are invited to participate in the Future Games Show, an online game show organized by GamesRadar, to exhibit online.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/fcc4cf8d762397d8bca9ed7e597322963d07668d.png[/img]

We didn’t know about the event because it was an overseas event(not famous in South Korea), so we didn’t sign up for it, but we got an email from the event producer saying that he played our demo of METAL SUITS and enjoyed it so much that he wanted to showcase our game METAL SUITS at the event.

Our METAL SUITS was featured in the “Ones to Play” section of the Future Games Show!


[b](3) Participating BitSummit 2024[/b]

“METAL SUITS” will be participating in BitSummit 2024, an offline event in Kyoto specializing in indie games. About 450 games were submitted for this year’s event, and luckily, “Metal Suits” passed the screening and will be able to attend.

https://bitsummit.org/en/game/metal-suits-en/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/ad7f03146369a47ca36276896589bcb9121271b9.png[/img]


[b](4) Participation BIC 2024 (Busan Indie Connect Festival) offline exhibition participation[/b]

We are participating in BIC 2024 with “METAL SUITS”. We participated in BIC in 2022 with a prototype of “METAL SUITS”, and now we’re excited to participate again with a nearly finished game.

If you’re coming to the Busan IndieConnect Festival, we’d love to say hello to you at the event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/18065d5b6dd026a88c51703c6431e4a94d032e89.png[/img]

==============================

Development of METAL SUITS is progressing steadily, and once the PC version is finished, we will port it to XBOX / PlayStation / Nintendo Switch.

We plan to attend as many exhibitions as possible before the release and if we have some issues, we’ll let you know what we are doing!

Thanks for reading to the end, and if you’re interested in our project, please like and follow us on the Steam.

notes.title: METAL SUITS, new planets Ladren, and new game mode
notes.content:
Hi all! I’m already writing my 16th development journal. Over the past two months, externally, we have won an award at the 2nd GYAAR Studio Indie Game Contest hosted by Bandai Namco and sponsored by SUPERCELL. Internally, we have been focusing hard on developing the game ahead of its release this year.

Although it is a side-scrolling action game, some airplane shooting game modes had to be included, so an airplane shooting game is also being produced and the final balance is being adjusted.

So far, we have introduced you to 7 planets. Today I would like to introduce you to the eighth planet, called Ladren.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][h2]1. Ladren[/h2][/b]
[b]1) Planet Description[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/b0c20638f708b1adda1043b1c9c68f99f642321e.png[/img]
<Eighth Planet Ladren>

Planet Ladren is a planet entirely covered in ice. It’s a barren planet like the previous planet Burniny.

Fortunately, light can penetrate the ice, and the residents live near the river that runs through the ice caves.

It’s an icy planet, but it’s also rumored that the reason it’s so warm underneath isn’t because of the light that reaches into the ice caves, but because there’s a huge, unknown energy source underground. Perhaps that’s why Golida took over this place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/e59e46a2d47956cb0adaa9f50a801423101b388e.png[/img]
<Ladren Planet Stage Configuration>

[b]2) Objects added to the planet Ladren[/b]

(1) Energy Ice Blocks

A block of ice in various shapes, but explodes on impact. They explode with a loud bang but don’t do any damage nearby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/8a52fd9b97c3b0ef65afb85eb709744d93731c7c.gif[/img]
<Energy Ice Blocks>


(2) Mystery Ice Chunks

These are chunks of ice that are formed by clusters of ice, presumably influenced by the terrain. Sometimes breaking them will reveal items, but other times they will reveal enemies frozen in the ice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/bfbaa9eb337c102cb28ef7c729d2a9ebe99bf0fa.gif[/img]
<Mystery Ice Chunks>


(3) Aerial Blocks

Aerial blocks placed by Golida will descend to the ground when their weight is detected. If no weight is detected, they will return to their original position, so make good use of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/c646eed94c41e7997f789ca9150bac87fcc72f5d.gif[/img]
<Aerial Blocks>


(4) Toxic Organisms

An organism that drops itself to spread poison when a creature comes near it and is only found on Radren.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/8f9fd9efdb25e36cfd1b716498268bb7f8fea8b2.gif[/img]
<Toxic Organisms>


(5) Wall Moving Saw Grinder

You’ve seen sawtooth wheels spinning on blocks before, but this time they’re sawtooths that travel along a defined path on a wall.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/9116a623f865fd92908a740433e966ba78a23a16.gif[/img]
<Wall Moving Saw Grinder>


(6) Laser Trap

A device that shoots lasers up and down every certain amount of time. Keep an eye on the timing and move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/972f914c515f89e15f5d06494a3fd72a590fa159.gif[/img]
<Laser trap that fires at a set interval>



[h2][b]2. Space Flight Shooting Mode[/b][/h2]

Chapter 8 adds a scenario in which Kevin flies an airship into space and battles enemy fighters and big spaceships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/0e5b4bb23186c0825c8854f38250e8cc90b35ed5.gif[/img]
<Space shooting game gameplay>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/83fab7108ba976b9828e4241d49d1286d3d9ca9d.gif[/img]
<Power-up kits will make your attacks more powerful>.

When you acquire a power-up kit, your ship can be enhanced five times.

Users can also get HP recovery, shields, and special skill items. We’re still working on this, so we’ll have more details when we’re done.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

That’s it for today’s devlog. I’ll be back in the next devlog to show you the last planet and more things we are developing.

Thank you for reading the game dev journal until the end, and if you are interested in our project, please add and follow us through Steam.

notes.title: METAL SUITS, new planets Noazm and Burniny
notes.content:
Hello, how are you all doing? It's been a while! It's been three months since I last posted a METAL SUITS development journal at the end of October 2023.

I know it's late, as January is already coming to an end, but I hope you all have a happy new year and that everything you want to do this year is going well!

Our METAL SUITS project is developing well and smoothly without any major issues. In order to ensure stable development and fast maintenance in the future, we have been refining the METAL SUITS project code from November to January, and it was completed without any major issues. And apart from refactoring, we are working hard to create new content.

Today we'd like to tell you about the new planets Noazm and Burniny.

------------------------------------------------
[h2][b]1. Noazm[/b][/h2]
[b]1) Planet Description[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/6b0b00ac286906fd71fa6513774bc564dfa1bec7.png[/img]
<Sixth Planet Noazm>

Noazm is a planet made up entirely of jungles and rivers, and among the giant trees that make up the jungles, there are ancient structures believed to have been built in ancient times, as well as various ancient devices that have never been seen before. What is Golida up to in a place like this?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/9a2a1d152f89709f6fab0ac3eb059b09d8301aef.png[/img]
<Noazm Planet Stage Configuration>

[b]2) Objects added to the planet Noazm[/b]
(1) Zipline
When users ride a zipline, users can go down quickly, and when users jump, users can also go to the other side of the zipline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/537715cda7d9d2d6f56b5bb450295bdf2cd888ad.gif[/img]
<Going Down the Zipline>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/da2189cd9e205e13fe49310eb28ee5fb2420691a.gif[/img]
<Zipline backward>

(2) Pressing switches and rising rocks
Pressable switch will work when pressed from up, left, and right. Users can use the switches to perform various gimmicks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/8451eb24a6d2d92805decaa9b989e77d0bb2076b.gif[/img]
<Pressable switches and rising rocks>

(3) Unfolding ladder
An unfolding ladder is a ladder that extends when triggered by a switch or when certain conditions are met. If you see a ladder like this on your screen, even if you can't climb it, keep an eye on your surroundings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/b259add40971e01eaf26706ada92a81b75ef5db1.gif[/img]
<Switch-activated unfolding ladder>

(4) Magic Stone Bridge
A magical stone bridge that unfolds when triggered by a switch or when certain conditions are met. Users can move the cursor down on the bridge to go under it. It's still in development, so there's a bit of a bounce to it, but it will be cleaned up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/754fadf6fb4586f3dea89fd1bab17bad20760e1f.gif[/img]
<Magic Stone Bridge will work when a condition is met>

[b]3) New enemies added to the planet Noazm[/b]
(1) Poison River and Piranha
The rivers on the planet Noazm are toxic and kill you if you touch them. And that's where the Noazm piranhas live, which are resistant to the toxic substance. If you're wearing a suit, you'll take damage, and if you're not wearing a suit, you'll die instantly if you touch them, so you have to be careful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/f691f31253d3be883006add6872850bbdfb8b270.gif[/img]
<Noazm Piranha>

(2) Golida Javelin
The first enemy to appear in Noazm is the Golida Javelin. Unlike the original Golida, this one throws spears. If you encounter it alone, it's easy to dodge as its spear flies in a parabola instead of a straight line, but if it's attacking with other Golidas, it can be difficult to avoid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/0268764a181bea9b855b15522dec7154f23a427b.gif[/img]
<Javelin Attack by Golida Javelin>

(3) Golida Vine
A wooden Golida mutant. Its wooden body makes it vulnerable to fire. It attacks with vine spikes through the ground, so jump when it gets into an attack stance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/e46a540ae4e25346e92378c9eb5bbeb38b00f10e.gif[/img]
<Wooden Golida Mutant Golida Vine>


[h2][b]2. Burniny[/b][/h2]
[b]1) Planet Description[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/6aaa4d0a0b8280b2d8e25c5a5effc3a4b18824ce.png[/img]
<Seventh Planet Burniny>

Burniny is a planet of red deserts, scorching hot and barren. The inhabitants of Burniny live in underground bases to escape the scorching heat. After the Golida invasion, they docked a large warship here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/51107acce7e257041cc7341334b6556d256fe446.png[/img]
<Burniny Planet — Battleship Stage Configuration>

[b]2) Objects added to the Burniny planet[/b]

In the case of Planet Burniny, the main battle is to infiltrate the inside of Golida's large battle ship and annihilate the enemy rather than planet exploration and combat.

(1) Rising Metal Box
It has a switch or a metal box that rises or falls when a condition is met. 6 It has the same function as the rising boulder from region Noazm, but we've changed the design so that it can be used inside the Golida people's airship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/fa077195d15505f2c7ce37cff61fb974e0750be5.gif[/img]
<Rising Metal Box>

(2) Mineral magma
There is magma created by melting a mineral that the Golida tribe uses as an energy source and kills instantly upon contact. It was designed to turn on/off for safety, as even the Golida tribes would die if touched. You can turn it on or off by achieving certain conditions or operating a switch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/452b0ae42c89ef9d5e0995f5db29b61c9743b15e.gif[/img]
<Mineral magma>

[b]3) Enemies added to the planet Burniny[/b]

(1) Golida Tri-Pod Sniper
It's one of the Tri-Pod attack machines. It targets the enemy and fires quick bullets one at a time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/62346cb85eefba2ee9d03abcdeb1018c59a2940c.gif[/img]
<Tri-Pod Sniper>

(2) Golida Tri-Pod Spider
When it spots an enemy with one of the Tri-Pod attack machines. It jumps in and performs a melee attack. As it is a mechanical robot or melee attack machine, its stamina is higher than that of other Tri-Pod machines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/a4860a43c887ba55729b3ae4beefdd5c0c83b172.gif[/img]
<Golida Tri-Pod Spider>

---

That's it for today's devlog. I'll be back in the next devlog to show you what's been developed further or what's currently in development.

The next post will be about the newly added planets and new game modes.

Thank you for reading the game dev journal until the end, and if you are interested in our project, please add and follow us on the Steam Store. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2093800/

notes.title: METAL SUITS, Introduction to newly added and changed suits
notes.content:
After completing the world’s largest exhibitions, Gamescom and Tokyo Game Show, by the end of September, our studio switched back to development mode starting in October.

New planets, enemies, and various objects are being added, but today I would like to tell you about newly added suits that have not been updated and changes to existing suits.

==============================
[h2]1. Kevin & Kyle[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/8dcbb542df5f62b0003fa4678cabf88c30118ac1.png[/img]
<Before and after changes to the Kevin>

Our main character, cyborg ‘Kevin’, has a slimmer torso and slightly fresher color than the first version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/dab58d5d6f7a4fbedefcef0f1326d0fa62e256e9.png[/img]
<Kyle, a cyborg clone of Kevin>

To support two-player local/multiplayer, ‘Kyle’, a cyborg clone of Kevin, also appears. To ensure clear separation in-game, Kyle has been created in a blue-based color and will remain in a blue-based color even when wearing any combat suit.

For a 2-player play, please check the sample video below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/a9955a346aabca314fbea37f82a7889ec632d37d.gif[/img]
<1P Kevin and 2P Kyle play together>

The UI in the video above is temporary so the UI will be configured to be neatly placed at the top of both sides at the time of release.


[h2]2. Cannon Bomb Suit[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/2ffb194d943b3004dd4283976b2fd913726fb144.png[/img]
<Before and after changes to the Cannon Bomb Suit>

The ‘Cannon Bomb Suit’ fires a powerful cannon, although the reload speed is a bit slow. The original form had Kevin wearing a duck-shaped tube-shaped suit, but with the update, it evolved into a form with a strong-shaped suit and a cannon in the middle of the chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/999d14cd4191bd247fe2367f6aea81ff9aa68eee.gif[/img]
<Cannon Bomb Suit Basic Attack>

The special skill of throwing the teddy bear and playing “I LOVE YOU” voice and then it splits into 4 grenades, is transferred to the Bear Bomb Suit. Afterward, a new chain explosion weapon was added as a special skill of the Cannon Bomb Suit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/3449b74f4a20347e591b384435b70d297ad5c999.gif[/img]
<Cannon Bomb Suit Special Skill>


[h2]3. Gatling Gun Suit[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/439274d5b93aefdfc4ed5f2f4832e4538111c991.png[/img]
<Before and after changes to the Gatling Gun Suit>

In the case of the ‘Gatling Gun Suit’, it was originally shown as holding a large gatling gun, but as it was updated, it was changed to a form where the suit was more stylish and holding a gatling gun with a longer barrel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/8ce2aa701996fe9885a6c8cd106385755ff36179.gif[/img]
<Gatling Gun Suit Basic Attack>

The form of the special skill is the same as before, but some effects have been strengthened.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/bc1a5b1bdbeb2a0094e0b2cbc6dfd299e5f7581f.gif[/img]
<Gatling Gun Suit Special Skill>


[h2]4. Firebug Suit[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/c53485eaa402d5c4e5d73e346c4ab8235df19357.png[/img]
<Before and after changes to the Firebug Suit>

The appearance of the ‘Firebug Suit’ has also been subtly changed. The details of the gas cylinder on his back have been improved, and the shape of the fire-breathing gun has also been improved.

Additionally, the appearance of the suit has been improved so that even the legs are completely protected from flames.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/4d36e775bc670d97959c1e2b2aa676bc7bca1856.gif[/img]
<Firebug Suit Basic Attack>

As you can see in the gif, the Firebug suit’s basic attack inflicts damage up to the bottom of the front.

The special skills of the Firebug Suit remain as powerful as before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/00091376facf66244b042d5d09b843aab1af5819.gif[/img]
<Firebug Suit Special Skill>


[h2]5. Electric Guitar Suit[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/98add6915a307b1ddc795d928b6237c34627c181.png[/img]
<Electric Guitar Suit>

There are no major changes to the ‘Electric Guitar Suit’ in appearance. Originally, machine gun-type bullets were fired from the guitar, but improvements are in progress as they lack differentiating points or characteristics compared to other suits. This part is still being improved through planning, development, and testing, so it is difficult to say how it will change at this point, but please look forward to it soon being changed to an even better version than the current version of firing bullets.

The special skill of the Electric Guitar Suit remains as splendid as before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/31253143f4eb6727783282fb90f93cc09df584ec.gif[/img]
<Electric Guitar Suit Special Skill>


[h2]6. Power Fist Suit[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/192ce9db08991d34a69aa2724ec9fcd8860f6e29.png[/img]
<Power Fist Suit>

The ‘Power Fist Suit’ does not have any major changes in appearance, but its basic attack speed has been increased and bullets fired by enemies can be deflected or exploded by the basic attack of the Power Fist Suit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/36da74212fad634be0376b36ce5dcf21fb10f34d.gif[/img]
<Power Fist Basic Attack>

In the case of the Power Fist suit, when using a special skill, it is converted into an invincible form that absorbs enemy attacks. The suit’s gauge has been improved so that it does not consume the gauge while invincible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/4fcd469d46318d62cc3cbd8f3ffa951e5ce24154.gif[/img]
<Power Fist Suit Special Skill>


[h2]7. Ninja Suit[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/668178754f95d515a484ad809d8dce7dfd92614d.png[/img]
<Ninja Suit>

This is a newly added ‘Ninja Suit’. It is a suit that has the appearance of a cyber ninja and can throw three shuriken. The shuriken is equipped with a high-performance sensor, so if there is an enemy or destructible object nearby, it can freely change direction to fly to that location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/be7b618dcc5aa6d1c2fa77c8ee2b869f04214847.gif[/img]
<Ninja Suit Basic Attack>

When using a special skill, 8 large shuriken are fired in 8 directions, and the shuriken reflects on the wall for a certain period of time and causes damage to enemies and objects in the space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/2b7a8559d3d39bb1706f91f1992f1e92a6d5c042.gif[/img]
<Ninja Suit Special Skill>

Please note that in the case of the ninja suit, the effect has not yet been applied when using special techniques.


[h2]8. Bear Bomb Suit[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/1fe776be42b4a8588cdf6a9eff45e99998e7e6aa.png[/img]
<Bear Bomb Suit>

This is the newly added bear-shaped suit ‘Bear Bomb Suit’. It is a suit that looks cute like a teddy bear, but moves quickly and throws powerful bombs in a parabolic direction.

The special feature of this suit is that it has the ability to throw bombs briefly or long depending on whether the attack button is pressed briefly or long. The bomb thrown by the Bear Bomb Suit is a sensor-equipped bomb that explodes when it touches an enemy or object, but when it touches a regular block, it rolls instead of exploding, so it will make good use of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/51f7bf758424091fe68fb7a41ee267ca9e543b17.gif[/img]
<Bear Bomb Suit Basic Attack>

The Bear Throw special skill of the existing Cannon Bomb Suit has been inherited from the Bear Bomb Suit. Be careful. Users can sometimes hear a creepy-low “I LOVE YOU” sound.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/6a252dbfe389f472add1cfc4aeb6753ab3c79ab6.gif[/img]
<Bear Bomb Suit Special Skill>


[h2]9. Lasersaber Suit[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/21d8c8872b226ac960f5c84c77281e018b5815ba.png[/img]
<Lasersaber Suit>

The newly added ‘Lasersaber Suit’ has a sturdy appearance and includes a lasersaber. You can attack using a laser sword and sword aura, and like the Power Fist, bullets fired by enemies using a sword and sword aura can be deflected or exploded by the basic attack

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/ccb757606a89c6b9368f9a8edf8bfcda511b3306.gif[/img]
<Lasersaber Suit Basic Attack>

In addition to the basic attack, the laser saber suit has an added feature that allows you to gather energy and attack with one flash by holding down the basic attack button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/d3a9a8358f0f0b837001e81e25e0009d983013c3.gif[/img]
<Lasersaber Suit One-flash Attack>

When the Lasersaber Suit uses a special skill, it instantly attacks all enemies exposed on the screen. I think you will understand quickly if you watch the below video.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/edfe04ba6c99dae5ee1b8ebbfb4e5701da4ca685.gif[/img]
<Lasersaber Suit Special Skill>


[h2]10. Drone Master Suit[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/cb57c6146c949b1451168856cceb12cad831ad0a.png[/img]
<Drone Master Suit>

This is the newly added ‘Drone Master Suit’ who has an ‘Afro hairstyle’.

The Drone Master Suit summons drones that orbit around him at regular intervals and has a basic attack that flies the drones at the target. Enemies and objects within a certain range are automatically set as targets, and enemies and objects behind walls also have very powerful basic attacks that can attack through walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/5ed2d60f023b9a2daa3479d7beceda72ae39a7f9.gif[/img]
<Drone Master Suit Basic Attack>

When you wear the Drone Master Suit and use a special skill, he will create 5 drones and launch them randomly at targets within the attack range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/ac81bdc9785be0045a4f0179cbc0d7c4df8794c7.gif[/img]
<Drone Master Suit Special Skill>

[h2]11. Angry Fist Suit[/h2] (wasted)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/0a23c7b402e8a8e38b649146613e52eb574ae69b.png[/img]
<Angry Fist Suit>

It was initially planned and developed with a dash attack using a shotgun and fists in mind, but it has been discarded because it lacked differentiation or character from existing suits (it also resembled characters from the some game too much;;;).
After release, we will review the suit again and if we can improve it in another way, we will try to improve it and add it.

==============================

This is a description of the basic Kevin & Kyle and 9 combat suits created to date. There are some suits that are still in development, so some effects are missing, but the suits in development will be completed by the time of release and an additional six types of suits will be added. Therefore, a total of 15 suits will be included in the game at launch.

The next post will explain the newly added planets and additional features.

Thank you for reading the game dev journal until the end, and if you are interested in our project, please add and follow us through Steam.

notes.title: METAL SUITS, Tokyo Game Show 2023 Exhibition Participation Review
notes.content:
Following exhibiting in Gamescom 2023 in August, we exhibited at Tokyo Game Show 2023 in September. Although it was smaller than Gamescom, it consisted of four large halls, and a separate space was provided for business meetings. All holes were organized a little tighter than at Gamescom, making it a very well-organized event overall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/a2396b3d54a82b6440a120c6a573101a538625e5.png[/img]
<TGS 2023 Configuration of the event venue>

The weather was very humid and hot, like summer in Korea. Even on the first day of the event, the B2B start date, the air conditioner did not work properly, so we had to sweat profusely during the event.

Unlike Gamescom, this time all the Eggtart Inc. members participated in the event. Although it was an immoderate decision at the company level, it was made with the hope that all members developing the game would have a variety of experiences by watching users play and react at the event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/1db5790a087e5edb5bb1706168eed2d9cac1a8ee.jpg[/img]
<Tokyo Game Show venue entrance signboard>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/b7c51803ccf22725216146462ab64f10f92ce191.jpg[/img]
<Booth setup a day before the event>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/0a8c3f88397bd271713054006c9750559573672c.jpg[/img]
<METAL SUITS booth with completed installation>

We were able to set up a booth in the Korean pavilion with support from the KOCCA(Korea Creative Content Agency), and during the four-day event period, the first two days were B2B and the remaining two days were B2C.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/df57c1e5450e8ba2c17671cc5927875bb736cc79.jpg[/img]
<Korean pavilion booth>

I think it was a big help to distribute press releases in Japan about 3 weeks before TGS with the help of a Japanese media person(Masa Kei - [url=https://twitter.com/MasaKei123]https://twitter.com/MasaKei123[/url]) I met by chance at the Banggusuk Indie Game Show before visiting the Tokyo Game Show.
Link - [url=https://automaton-media.com/articles/newsjp/20230831-262460/]Go to the press release link in Japan[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/d57bba81c1a41da00565e5e35b66e2a99971fd31.png[/img]
<Press release in Japan distributed on August 31st>

Additionally, the press release was viewed more than 90,000 times on Twitter. We would like to thank Masa Kei from Japan for his great help with this post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/8ce33c01d6b5bc93857b9ee9ab2a52fe590ae3bd.png[/img]
<Press release in Japan viewed over 90,000 times on Twitter>

Many people came to our booth during the event. About 20 people cleared the boss. They showed superior gaming skills than the German visitors who visited Gamescom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/b79d3e42c3ab8fa1da1b87233e89781b3a778f72.png[/img]
<Visitors visiting the booth and enjoying METAL SUITS>

What was most impressive about this event was the coverage by local media and Korea Ruliweb. All of the reporters cleared the boss in one play. Not only were their gaming skills good, but the article was so in-depth that I could tell that they were a user who had played a lot of the genre over the years.
Link - [url=https://news.denfaminicogamer.jp/kikakuthetower/230923k]Go to the local media article in Japan[/url]
Link - [url=https://bbs.ruliweb.com/news/read/187727]Go to the Ruliweb's coverage article[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/90c703fafa3576389f89e16fdac55aac055b7ddd.png[/img]
<Coverage article captured photos>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/439bd6989a65e1854c88b217c22e61cf0ebeade0.jpg[/img]
<A picture of me looking like a fighter(?) at the end of a Japanese article>

And a person named "ゴロー2000才" from Dengeki Online, who is famous in Japan, visited and filmed a video.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/e0780af37237e6105fddf4ec4c725ff84185d4a7.png[/img]
<Capture image from ゴロー2000才's YouTube video>

Link - [url=https://twitter.com/goro2000sai]Go to ゴロー2000才's Twitter[/url]
Link - [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=60LuFFmWuMo&t=950s]Watch ゴロー2000才's METAL SUITS gameplay video[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/76689613cde7424e33453152a19d3e037ea74ed2.jpg[/img]
<Last day of the exhibition, PD who is having a hard time>

After the 4-day exhibition, we returned with a successful conclusion to the event. If the many doubts we had internally through Gamescom 2023 turned into confidence, in the Tokyo Game Show 2023, we gained great confidence that our game could be worked globally. Additionally, as all of the members participated in the exhibition event, I think everyone, including me, developed a similar sense of self-confidence. And above all, I think the great achievement is that we have become a stronger team than before through exhibitions in events and training camps(?).

==================================================

We had business meetings with many domestic and global companies at the Tokyo Game Show 2023, and we plan to do our best to produce good results through continuous consultation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/a0449a3392eb4f573df4f2b8ec0eeb8c45a62b66.jpg[/img]
<Kevin Cosplay, the protagonist of the upgraded METAL SUITS presented at the Tokyo Game Show 2023>

In the next post, I will explain the added suits and new planets.
Thank you for reading the game dev journal until the end, and if you are interested in our project, please add and follow us.

notes.title: METAL SUITS, Gamescom 2023 Exhibition Participation Review
notes.content:
For the first time in my life, I visited Gamescom, the world’s largest gaming event. The world’s largest game show that we only heard about. The scale was truly amazing. There are a total of 11 large halls the size of BEXCO or KINTEX in Korea. However, there is also a hall on two floors, so you can think of a total of about 15 large halls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/a41d8219a7216064b4c5e653cd346a2c9f6c2416.png[/img]
<Gamescom hall composition - Halls 2, 3, 4, 10, and 11 are composed of two floors>

The weather was very humid and hot on the first day, but then it became a decent summer day. When I returned to Korea, the weather in Köln was similar to the fall weather in Korea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/b79a42e90d2e6db9cbdbbfa0c087c8f968f401e5.jpg[/img]
<Entrance to the Gamescom event venue - If you can find someone in the pic, it will be because of their mood.>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/60d5d98f4f1345074e25a1d11cc94783634becf2.jpg[/img]
<Two days before the event. The entrance to the event venue with few people>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/9f8fc15a2ab274a6e5f5734fb81cc7ff40d64f2c.jpg[/img]
<B2C Home of Indie Area with booth being set up>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/7ed5e3539b5e7b01d3764e798bcbaeb9fb5c0ed7.jpg[/img]
<B2C Home of Indie Area with booth being set up>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/c6d800c04c9cf4badacafe991ff7d9757be4ccf0.jpg[/img]
<A hallway with few people during the Gamescom B2B period>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/c5eae638eaa7c2df0b208079b3966f305171b40c.jpg[/img]
<A huge number of people moving during the B2C period>

With support from the KOCCA(Korea Creative Content Agency), our Egg Tart also opened a B2B business booth in the Korea Joint Pavilion. And we were curious about user reactions and feedback about our game, so we set up a booth in B2C called Home of Indie at a separate cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/946d48c0719b6ac2f6055b1bc34577214d5593ca.png[/img]
<B2B Korea Pavilion Booth>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/a5a74e15ae61af246bbc47e71353adcff3aa8448.jpg[/img]
<Metal Suit Booth in Home of Indie>


B2B was from Wednesday (23rd) to Friday (25th), and B2C was from Thursday (24th) to Sunday (27th).

When we visited to set up the B2C booth on Wednesday for the exhibition, many B2B people came to the B2C booth and played games. Perhaps that’s why there were many people who played the game at the B2C booth and then came to the B2B booth to request a meeting.

Thanks to this, we were able to hold many meetings in addition to those scheduled in advance in B2B. If you are going to attend an exhibition reading this article, don’t just go to B2B or B2C, make sure to go to B2B and B2C together!! (But don’t forget that it’s twice as hard)

By the way, this time I cosplayed as our “METAL SUITS” protagonist, Kevin. It was a business trip and the conditions were not good, but as the CEO, I did my best.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/46cb4b8a594ce7512f8acd7e4e1d3e3b2a5de7f5.png[/img]
<METAL SUITS Protagonist Kevin Cosplay>

====================================


“METAL SUITS” gained some popularity in the B2B and B2C booths. We had meetings with over 20 companies at the B2B booth, and users constantly visited the B2C booth to enjoy games.

notes.title: METAL SUITS, New Planet Estiel, and GamesCom 2023
notes.content:
This month’s development log is a little late. There are many things to prepare for attending Gamescom (B2B, B2C) and the Tokyo Game Show exhibition, so I was able to write it only on the last day of July.

Originally, I was going to write about the changed part ahead of the exhibition, but I will explain the new planet because it is still in preparation.

Today, I would like to explain the new planet Estiel and the Gamescom exhibition scheduled to attend in August.

================================

[h3]1. Estiel[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/5411412c90fe4afdf6b9cda171769b33cd947b98.png[/img]
<The fifth Planet Estiel - Estiel>

The Estiel is a planet made up of deserts, and there are many ancient structures built in the desert, who do not know who or when they were built.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/1f9407c3bf10bae9970c17ed66cf40b3e350ce8b.png[/img]
<Estiel Planet Stage Configuration>

Why did the Golida tribe invade Estiel, where no one lives? Did he go to wake up a giant device with unknown powers inside an ancient building that is said to be legendary? As it is a desert area, you never know what might be hiding in the sand, so you should always be careful.

[h3]2. Objects added to the planet Estiel[/h3]
(1) Blocks that fall when stepped on
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/785853f9cfc79202ca227e87440188de5ececac7.gif[/img]
<Blocks that fall when stepped on>

If you step on the falling block, the block will fall and Kevin will fall as well. Don’t hesitate and move quickly. Don’t worry too much. After a while, the block will reappear.

(2) Grinder tooth that moves along the block
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/c56c250b0b436195e188efca41c7f852d050913e.gif[/img]
<Grinder tooth>

The grinder tooth moves along the block. If you are wearing a suit when you touch it, the suit will be destroyed immediately, and if you do not have a suit, you will die instantly, so be careful.

(3) A thorn block that rises when stepped on
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/5f078542c0c5db0c66f49c17ca7adb4cdf29e94c.gif[/img]
<A thorn block placed inside an ancient building>

If you step on a thorn block installed inside an ancient building, thorns will pop up from the floor. If you are stabbed by a thorn, if you are wearing a suit, the suit is immediately destroyed, and if you are not wearing a suit, you will die instantly, so be careful.

(4) Blocks coming out and coming in of walls
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/c5f73e1ad309a52daa55909350cf9681aa15f30d.gif[/img]
<Blocks coming out and coming in of walls>

Inside the ancient building, blocks are placed that come out of the wall. Get the timing right when you come out and when you go in. If you get it wrong, you can fall into the very depths of the ancient structure.


[h3]3. Enemies added to Estiel planet[/h3]

(1) Golida Slime
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/ce84e3ada8fa7a39bc952bea200491eacbdd7120.gif[/img]
<Golida Slime>

Golida Slime exhales toxic substances from its mouth. Be careful, if you come into contact with the gas of toxic substances, or if you come into contact with toxic substances, you will slow down, take damage and die.


(2) Golida Mage
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/f23761179e4d169d57797672e6daf797d23541dd.gif[/img]
<Golida Mage>

Golida Mage has very weak, but absorbs Kevin’s attacks and launches a powerful counterattack.


(3) Golida Scarab
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/5c0e302d378b76a45a4daa1f81de199f09a0437a.gif[/img]
<Golida Scarab>

Swarms of giant Gollida scarabs that live inside ancient structures. Be careful as you can get stabbed by its huge teeth if you get near it.

[h3]4. GamesCom 2023[/h3]
We will attend both the 2023 Gamescom B2B and B2C exhibitions.

B2B will participate in a Korean pavilion with the support of the Korea Creative Content Agency, and B2C will exhibit at the booth as a member of the Home of Indie group.

If you happen to come to the exhibition, you can get a chance to play the METAL SUITS demo we prepared and you can get two kinds of goods.

Even if you just play the game, we will give you a fan, and if you answer the survey, we will also give you a key ring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/ad5e5e7d9067ee31903188fea02111c49e5711be.png[/img]
<METAL SUITS Fan>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/6ddbd41ecd3ae861ff6a55ae13e050db45221158.png[/img]
<Kevin Keyring of METAL SUITS>

================================

In the next post, I will go to the exhibition and leave a review of the Gamescom 2023 exhibition!

Thank you for reading the development log to the end. If you are interested in our project, please follow us and wishlist us on Steam.

notes.title: METAL SUITS, New Planet Tenal, and Improvements
notes.content:
This is already the 10th dev journal of “METAL SUITS”. METAL SUITS is confirmed to participate in GamesCom(B2B, B2C) and Tokyo Game Show (B2C) exhibitions this year, and will participate in exhibitions at BIC (Busan Indie Connect Festival).

Today I am going to talk about the new planet Tenal and how it’s improved over the original game.

--------------------------------------------------

[h3]1. Tenal[/h3]

This is Tenal, the fourth planet of Metal Suits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/e4ebc04d4454911e1c42b1286289ad9b6a9d1d18.png[/img]
<The fourth planet - Tenal>

Tenal is a planet made entirely of machines. As a factory planet in the Hellios system, it is difficult to tell whether it is day or night as it produces various mechanical devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/3f96705f67b45d41d6c35a4b13bc94f324e4e0c9.png[/img]
<Tenal screen configuration>

Your mission this time is to defeat the Golida tribes who have conquered the planet Tenal, where you can produce various mechanical devices. As it is a factory planet, there are various obstacles, so you should always play carefully.


[h3]2. Objects added to the planet Tenal[/h3]

(1) Portal & Portal Circle
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/69b6944b92e5f5ae5136afc541afb174550918c8.gif[/img]
<Moving through the portal>

Users can move to other areas connected to the portal through the portal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/e2d32553aec6b46e7f5d94e449274d4fba255c03.gif[/img]
<Portal circle - users can only come out through the circle>

The portal is configured to be able to enter and exit, but in the case of the portal circle, it is configured to only be able to exit.
You never know where the portal will lead, so always be careful before entering it.


(2) Jump platform
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/d1999e3608d45c9d7426dc735b8fce92bde0c64c.gif[/img]
<Jump platform>

Climbing on a jump platform will make you jump upwards. It works by the same mechanism as the ‘Spring mushroom’ from the planet Mushdora.


(3) Steampipe
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/0d67c1ff9c786c6ed9e5b8b42771932ff8d3261a.gif[/img]
<Steampipe>

It is a steampipe from which hot gas is ejected. A small burst of steam is released from the cracked pipe before it erupts, followed by a large burst of steam after a period of time. Contact with steam can cause death, so be careful.


(4) CCTV Gun

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/2b102d294fc395c4a5c89afa5f4afc3a7c7647ff.gif[/img]
<CCTV Gun>

It is a device with a gun attached to CCTV to defend against trespassing enemies. It cannot be destroyed, so be aware of the CCTV and move around while avoiding bullets.


(5) Electric guard

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/19d8e7be51882f0767b1ae4da931942e7a33758a.gif[/img]
<Activating and deactivating Electric Guard>

An electrical guard that is activated by default and impassable, but becomes inactive when certain conditions are met (using a lever, etc.).


(6) Responsive door

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/8a0b0828f9cbdf00444d7e9c64b196db7e1263b7.gif[/img]
<Responsive door>

It is a responsive door designed to open when a certain area is reached. It doesn’t open that fast.

[h3]3. Added Enemies to the Tenal Planet[/h3]

(1) Golida Jet and the Shockwave Machine

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/e04933c7d6c3f94131e0e0bcef54bec38879f002.gif[/img]
<Golida Jet and the Shockwave Machine>
The Golida Jet is a Golida-type unit that attacks from the air with a jet engine attached to its back, and the Shockwave Machine is a mechanical unit that attacks by firing shockwaves at ground units. Shockwaves will be fired in both directions, so be careful.


(2) Golida Scientist

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/863dbf63a5acc125fc66958c1c1c877fb09a72ec.gif[/img]
<Golida scientists panic when they see Kevin>
Golida scientists are purely research scientists so they do not attack.


(3) Mad Golida scientist

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/c5707ae22727d9986db8e5172898aac27cff7f92.gif[/img]
<Mad Scientist’s Red/Blue Flask Attack>

The Mad Golida Scientist will attack by throwing a red or blue flask. Red flasks turn into pillars of fire, and blue flasks turn into paralyzing gas.


(4) Robot Dog

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/4ed4a351d04eb7a495558e88c25db1da7fd3780b.gif[/img]
<Robot Dog>

The robot dog sounds an alarm when it detects an enemy. When the alarm goes off, enemies will spawn from nearby Golida Warp Doors. Also, watch out for the robot dog as it will lunge near Kevin.


[h3]4. METAL SUITS advancement work[/h3]
METAL SUITS is under development, but since the exhibition is ahead, the overall game is in the process of upgrading. Added lights and improved various effects.

(1) Improved light, fog area, chapter 1 background, and added rain effect

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/85746daa7fa99ac11204279ebe5f8cf15121e113.gif[/img]
<Before light/fog area/background/rainy effect applied>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/ff9fceb5305af5e1a911fa0d084db6f5d894042c.gif[/img]
<After applying light/fog area/background/rainy effects>


(2) Improved effect when using Gatling Suit special skill

Significant improvements have been made to the overall UI and effects when using Gatling Suit special skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/108960bc4e33b28c1a34893322c5cdb4437409c3.gif[/img]
<Before Gatling Gun special effect improvement>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/59884e05fd239f0869125dff2c64b616177dbb76.gif[/img]
<After Gatling Gun special effect improvement>

--------------------------------------------------

In the next post, I will focus on explaining the changes ahead of the exhibition.

Thank you for reading the development log to the end. If you are interested in our project, please wishlist it.

notes.title: METAL SUITS, Share the improvements in progress
notes.content:
Hi all. Originally, we wanted to introduce the newly added planet at this time, but we would like to introduce the parts that are improving as new members join the team. Therefore, we will introduce the newly added planets the next time.
This time, we’re going to tell you about the company’s changes and the changes we’re preparing or improving in the game.

------------------------------------------------------------


[h3]1. Growth of Eggtart Inc[/h3]

Around this time last year, members continued to be joined to our team, which had been producing metal suits with three people and now has become a large organization with seven members.
This year, a PD with 25 years of game experience, who is called a legend (?) in the domestic game development industry, has officially joined, and an effector/TA who will breathe life into the game to make it look more colorful, and a talented person who loves game development also joined.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/aeded79706adc50154f46db95005bd66d6e0b572.png[/img]
<Eggtart Office — Team members doing their best>

Until the release of “METAL SUITS”, we will proceed with game production with a system of 7 crew. Please continue to support us!


[h3]2. Testing 2D lights[/h3]

“METAL SUITS” is a 2D game, but in order to give a more sense of depth, we have completed testing to add 2D lights and are working on applying them to some stages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/51ff8ba71f34ed949ff6b42a977ea01645750ad0.gif[/img]
<2D light added around the character>

Some stages and areas are being designed so that they can proceed by generating light in the dark, so please look forward to it.


[h3]3. Suit design improvements[/h3]

(1) We improved the design by taking advantage of a few more characteristics of the suits I worked on previously.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/4259559acaeda314434a6ede1e406cb124888cb3.png[/img]
<Left: before improvement, Right: after improvement>

(2) Change the idle animation behavior for each suit

Animations that were previously sprite animations have been changed to Spine animations. In the directing video below, the pixels look diagonal, but in the actual game, Pixel Perfect will be applied and they will look neat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/9675d1925ebf3e61f31c082a5a3b7c939486d19a.gif[/img]
<Previous idle animation>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/bca63c800a878add1252241f499fc0b0898e1b9b.gif[/img]
<Improved idle animation>


[h3]4. Effect improvements[/h3]

(1) Improvements where enemy attacks were not visible in the explosion scene

There are various explosion scenes as the goal of game production is to make hot battles, but we are improving things that were not able to avoid enemy attacks due to being covered by explosives during play. (Before applying the build)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/cf8feb6c40c7bda733520c5e71efe4ad4ac0334b.gif[/img]

<Enemy attacks visible behind the explosion effect>
(2) Suit wear / destroy effect improvement

Previously, it was treated as a simple effect when wearing a suit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/0aa4633982602fcae22302edc35441700f0505c8.gif[/img]
<Previous suits wearing effect>

However, this time, the suit-wearing and destroy effects have been improved as follows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/9eae15043117b9c1b4fb66308db18ad731288c1b.gif[/img]
<Improved suit wear effect>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/74bc1cc9c8c3da624781a7e79a715decb2635a41.gif[/img]
<Improved suit destroy effect>

(3) Improved the effect when Kevin dies

When Kevin died, he died a little bit better(?).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/4ac765e7ee67a6870e27e64f4870732be4cf96b6.gif[/img]
<Previous Kevin death effect>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/a4853ef9de25f55764daf31eee2ba9df06523edd.gif[/img]
<Improved Kevin death effect>


[h3]5. Sound improvements[/h3]

Previously, an audio listener was attached to the camera, and all sounds visible on the screen were played regardless of distance. As a result, it is difficult to play various sounds according to the character’s movement and there is no sense of distance. In order to solve this problem, we are working on improving it so that you can feel the sound change according to the environment by applying 3D sound and putting various sounds related to the environment at a certain point with each object.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/5f562bc24d07ac2cfcab0fac0e145b50516ee3cd.png[/img]
<Applying 3D sound>

------------------------------------------------------------

In this post, we told you about various sections that have been improved since new employees joined the company. In the next post, I will explain the new chapter(Planet) that is under development.

Thank you for reading the development log to the end. If you are interested in our project, please add your wishlist it.

notes.title: METAL SUITS, New planet Elgnu
notes.content:
[h2][b]1. Elgnu[/b][/h2]
The third planet of METAL SUITS is Elgnu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/d074f82149a258e65e6534410531021013aa0c0d.png[/img]
<The third planet Elgnu>

Planet Elgnu is a resource-rich planet that produces and supplies all minerals, which are energy sources consumed within the Helios planetary system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/75f26598d4548230fc63582ada489dff91ac9f1f.png[/img]
<Elgnu Stage Configuration Screen>

Thus, the main battleground on the planet Elgnu is a mineral mining mine within a cave-like terrain. This mission is to defeat the Golidas who occupied the mines that produce minerals, which are energy sources in the Helios planetary system.

[h2][b]2. Objects added to Elgnu[/b][/h2]
(1) Mineral block
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/8b31eaf33e7fea9ff30c11cbaecf4e9981271f05.png[/img]
<Emerald-colored Mineral Block>

Mineral blocks with an emerald color are slightly smaller than normal blocks. If you hit it, it will burn, and if you touch it while it is burning, you will take damage, so be careful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/db02055a6029ca5e65f571a177ae4a6be544de0a.gif[/img]
<Burning Mineral Block>

(2) Conveyor Belt & Mineral Generator

A conveyor belt placed in the middle of the map for the purpose of transporting minerals. Because it moves in the direction of the arrow, it moves fast in one direction and slow in the other. The mineral generators placed here and there are configured so that the minerals produced at regular intervals fall. If you get hit by minerals, you will die even if you are wearing a suit, so be careful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/638241b847c6582043048b478f37ffa08dc6b796.gif[/img]
<Basic Operation of Conveyor Belt>

(3) Moving block

A block that appears on the wall and disappears into the wall after moving a certain distance. They are placed all over the mine, but you need to be careful when using them because they disappear into the wall when you move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/fa6ad5375974c243cf894f30bf3f3268f2ccee8b.gif[/img]
<Moving block>

(4) Presser

Pressers with different speeds are installed all over the map. Even if you are wearing a suit, you will die if you are crushed by the pressure, so you must move carefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/5560a8f02c74d3e3d1feed166912a2ba699f5301.gif[/img]
<Presser>

(5) Blast furnace

There are also flaming furnaces placed in the middle of the map for mineral crafting. If you fall in to the fire, you will die instantly, so you must cross carefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/7155c70c121c9d303636941f63e11522bdf881fa.gif[/img]
<You will die instantly if you fall into the furnace>

(6) Electric barricade

There are electrical barricades that you simply cannot pass through. Some field barricades are configured to turn off by actuating a lever or de-energizing them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/5e420757bc7186662a4b651b598b5b45bc095272.gif[/img]
<Electric barricade>

[h2][b]3. Enemies and gadgets added to Elgnu[/b][/h2]

(1) Suicide drone

Red Suicide Drones guard the mines. The moment it recognizes the enemy, it is configured to rush and explode. Drones cannot change direction, so dodge them if they try to attack you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/9fe1fad0c9732a8d7005d199bbcf1ac6fec167e5.gif[/img]
<Suicide Drone percept enemy and attack>

(2) Golida Disk

An aerial attack unit, a single-person flying vehicle ridden by the Golidas. Fires single bullets in the air.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/c01ea20ef58569b8f4353637a78981596b6b8023.gif[/img]

(3) Golida alert machine and Golida warp door

When a Golida soldier activates the Golida Alert Machine, enemies will warp to the nearby Golida Warp Door. If possible, act quickly to prevent the Golida soldiers from activating the Golida alert machine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/cb4b032c3d06c0d03d588b27cbdb322e76e45f8e.gif[/img]
<Activation and operation of the Gollida alert machine>

(4) Golida Worker

This is a robot used for mining in mines. Since it’s for mining, it doesn’t fire lasers or missiles, but it can attack by extending its arms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/c4fb5cff4d5dd1db7b41b57f8e928d31e86099dc.gif[/img]
<Golida Worker>

(5) Golida paratroopers

Golida Paratroopers descending from the air. It is a unit that descends quickly, deploys its parachute before reaching the ground, and attacks quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/08d405cc75bb907ebe3fa1f3edf83b59c632ae14.gif[/img]
<Golida paratroopers>

------------------------------------------

[h3]※ We received a pen art as a gift for the first time. The main character of METAL SUITS is handsome Kevin.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/cfb9782ec399cb83cd28a395adf3e9f0cf135924.jpg[/img]

------------------------------------------

Many elements were developed and added in the last month. In the next post, I will explain the new chapter (Planet) that is under development.

Thank you for reading the development log to the end. If you are interested in our project, please like it.

notes.title: METAL SUITS, new planet Mushdora

<Exploding poisonous mushroom>

<Difficulty path with various thorns installed>

[b](4) Power sources, wires, and connectors[/b]
A new device from Mushdora, the power source is a device that supplies energy. It is configured to transmit power through wires.
Therefore, when the power is connected from the power source, it can be connected and operated with various objects which need power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/154352223552a727df63912895c2aa0c8740f24b.gif[/img]
<Turning the connector to supply power>

If there is a connector in an unconnected place, a melee attack can rotate the connector, and power can be channeled through the rotated connector to drive the device.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/2f1217b22b18afdd2706c1b11a3bad4756d42aaf.png[/img]

Various puzzle devices using power sources and connectors will be provided, so please look forward to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/64963ec57c2bbfaee1f9abd69d701330943a9858.png[/img]
