notes.title: METAL SUITS, background style, in-game UI, hidden elements, and new chapters
notes.content:
Over the past month, METAL SUITS has been applying changes that are close to metamorphosis.

With a new Head of Art on board, we’re making a number of design improvements and changes. Some of the biggest changes include

[list]
[*] Changes to background style and in-game UI
[*] Added hidden elements and collectibles
[*] Added new chapter (planet) concept
[/list]

Let me explain each of the additions/modifications.

------------------------------------------------------------

[h3]1. Changing the way backgrounds style and changing the in-game UI[/h3]
In the previous version, we applied a square design that utilized the square grid when placing background blocks. Since the empty background blocks also had a square shape like the previous blocks, the overall image looked angular and sharp, but with this change, we changed the background to be smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/e41116bb9833c7bb50272f6bc74757e27c56f71a.png[/img]
<Screenshot before changing the background style>


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/3b4173590b9c7e0fe644604e2158d8787172bd79.png[/img]
<Screenshot after changing the background style>

We also moved the character status UI from the bottom left of the screen to the top left, so that you can see your character's status at a glance.

Another change we made was to make the blocks outside of the player's movement area black to make them more focused on the game. We also made the actual block colors a little lighter, so that the areas where the character is moving are a little more highlighted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/8a1cd920b1f178a180fd5bae3ad009f059d5eb33.png[/img]
<Before : no black area>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/a6437d78d42bb98e8b82722e1d4691fac9f68282.png[/img]
<After : black outside of play area>

[h3]2. Add hidden elements and collectibles[/h3]
Overall, each stage contains a mix of combat elements and puzzles, and hidden elements and collectible elements have been added to provide a more fun game for those who play meticulously. There are two types of hidden elements that can be obtained.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/b5e8b07737d6aac6f9a394e59ae5f40acb070895.png[/img]
<UPC Trophy Box, Extra Life Box, UPC Trophy, Extra Life>.

When you destroy the UPC trophy box, the UPC trophy appears. At the bottom of the chapter selection screen, the number of collectible elements to be collected for each chapter and the number actually collected is displayed. (Currently under development, it is displayed as 0)

For extra life items, sometimes they come in boxes and sometimes they are placed on their own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/a5324df6429665c1a13592e873faa96cdcf45dd6.png[/img]
<Show number of trophies to collect per chapter>

The hidden elements described above can be discovered as you progress through the game. As you can see by comparing the two images below, I found a life box inside a hidden wall. If you hit the box and break it, a heart that can add +1 to your life will come out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/d7b6bbb3afc553c6572432b884fac539d885d64a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/c2d2eea977c99646811fa19e6020a08459b0eaf0.png[/img]

<Image of the hidden element before (above) and after (under) discovery>

In addition to UPC trophies and life boxes, there may also be suit boxes or item boxes, so it's worth checking them out if you come across a suspicious wall in your game.

[h3]3. New Chapter planet - Mushdora[/h3]
This is Mushdora, the second planet of METAL SUITS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/edd45d705367f62c580c76a45e1752406bf6a1b1.png[/img]
<Mushdora>

Mushdora is a planet with many craters, valleys, and mushroom-like plants growing inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/1fac9db0d4e7925449d49cc1d89ce37f2cd1ac9f.png[/img]
<Mushdora Stage Screen>

As the environment changes, 3 more enemies will appear in addition to the previously appeared Golida enemies.

[b](1) Golida Orc[/b]
Golida Orcs are larger and have more stamina than normal Golidas. When it spots an enemy, it actively approaches it, and when it comes within range, it launches a powerful shoulder dash attack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/8f69f8f552e41d73de5217494c20ca9a6ed5838b.png[/img]
<Golida Orc>

[b](2) Golida Tri-pod - Laser & Missile[/b]
The Golida Tri-Pod is an attack robot that Golida rides on. It is classified into robots that fire lasers and robots that fire missiles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/ee437af0def1fc1b0be1effbf5eb091069147738.png[/img]
<Golida Tri-Pod Laser (left) & Missile (right)>

The laser pod fires 6 lasers in rapid succession, so be careful. Missile pods only fire two missiles, but they are guided missiles and should be avoided or destroyed.

------------------------------------------------------------

In the next post, we will explain the new objects, gimmicks, and new chapters (planets) that will be added to Mushdora.
Thank you for reading the development log to the end. If you are interested in our project, please add it to your steam wishlist.

notes.title: METAL SUITS, the worldview & Kevin
notes.content:
In AD 3019, humans left behind the devastated Earth due to reckless development and migrated to H-B998, which exists in the Hellios system.

For humans at that time, moving to the Hellios system was not an easy task. Frankly, it was very difficult with the technology at the time, and the probability of success could have been higher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/cc20993dece9a2d0549bfd68c8074e44de6bf082.png[/img]
<Planet H-B998 in the Hellios system>

About 10 million migrants, it was expected that it would take about 250 years of space flight from the Earth to the Hellios system H-B998, and it was unclear whether humans could actually settle in H-B998, which exists in the Hellios system. According to Kilian's memoirs, who was the commander-in-chief of migrants at the time, the probability that humans could settle after the arrival of H-B998 at the time of departure was less than 10%.

During the flight, about 40% of the migrants died due to airship problems, such as the hibernation machine's failure or the life support system, and about 20% of the personnel deviated from the route due to a failure of the autopilot system so we don't know where they went.

In the end, it is said that only about 40% of the number of people who departed survived and arrived at H-B998.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/162643445663c720da53b9d28cda7b8700c43d66.png[/img]
<'New Earth' in the Hellios system>

After approximately 252 years of flight, humans settled on H-B998 in AD 3273 and named the planet New Earth. Fortunately, H-B998 was suitable for humans to live on, and since there were no other life forms inhabiting the planet, humans could quickly settle down based on science and technology brought from Earth.

As humans settled on the new Earth, AD ended and the Great Space Age AS (Anno Cosmos) began.

------------------------------------------------------------

In AS 3, humans who quickly settled on the New Earth based on science and technology brought from Earth investigated the Hellios system and found that intelligent life exists on all planets except Earth among a total of 10 planets in the Hellios system.

Fortunately, all life forms were not aggressive, so humans made relationships through dialogue with all races, and for peace, the Hellios Planet Union UP (United Planets) was created and the Hellios peacekeeping force, UPC (United Planets Command) was established.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/0730ab51b1ac82a4734b485dfcd3de27c5ea8d7d.png[/img]
<UPC (United Planets Command) Logo>

For about 1,000 years after that, each planet shared technology and resources through mutual exchanges and developed their own civilization peacefully.

------------------------------------------------------------

In AS 997, the Hellios system, which has been maintained for about 1000 years, is in crisis due to a large-scale invasion by a one-eyed race called the Golida.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/5dafd06a814b1ae5e07cfb4faf3e3ba4f884fe29.png[/img]
<Golida tribe - Contrary to its appearance, it is very hostile and aggressive.>

The Golida tribe, which appeared with a large army, occupied all 10 planets in the Hellios system in just 7 days using various weapons made with advanced science and technology. Embarrassed by the surprise attack, the UPC tried everything they could, but it was not enough to stop the large and powerful force of the Golida.

All ground and air bases and facilities of the UPC were destroyed by the attack of the Golida tribe, and only the secret ship 'Hellisium' operated by the UPC and combat units of some planets managed to escape out of Hellios system without being detected.

In AS 1002, the UPC, which had reunited around Hellisium and prepared for war, launched a massive counterattack by mobilizing most of the troops in the entire army. However, this counterattack also ended in failure due to the overwhelming firepower and troops of the Golida tribe. After the invasion of the Golida tribe, Lieutenant Colonel Kevin, who was leading the battle against the Golida tribe, was seriously injured and unconscious, but managed to return to Hellisium with the help of the artificial intelligence Ellix.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/e66584d859ad37721a36c4ffa325f7abc48d0db0.png[/img]
<AI 'Ellix>

------------------------------------------------------------

The UPC, on the defensive due to the failure of a large-scale counterattack, withdraws Hellisium near of Hellios system and prepares a new strategy.

As an all-out war is difficult due to the difference in troops, they wanted to create a powerful combat robot and infiltrate it into each planet with the artificial intelligence Ellix to defeat all the Golida. In fact, it was planned from the beginning, but building a suitable robot has failed over the years.

In the end, UPC decided to use the unconscious lieutenant colonel Kevin's brain to create a combat cyborg that could be changed into various shapes, and Dr. Kang, an odd genius scientist, completed the production of the combat cyborg 'Kevin' after two years of research and production.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/487d7b08d1b810f7f384ec667a1d8edcd3ed14f5.png[/img]
<Combat cyborg 'Kevin'>

Shortly after Kevin's production was completed, the Golida attacked Hellisium, and Kevin and Ellix were put on a small airship according to protection protocol and released to the other side of Hellisium, and the legend of 'Metal Suits' began.

------------------------------------------------------------

In the next post, we will explain inside of New Earth and changed background design, added basic objects, hidden elements on the stage, and collectibles.

From the next post, it will be posted once every 4 weeks. Thanks for reading to the end.

notes.title: METAL SUITS, Basic game objects
notes.content:
On the planets invaded and conquered by the Golidas tribes, there are various objects from Golida tribes. Objects are divided into unbreakable objects, breakable objects, and explodable objects.

[b]1. Unbreakable Objects[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/7513b95e98f9cceba5b88b9e10c4929eed042985.png[/img]
<Iron Box>

- Iron Box : It's an iron box used by the Golida tribes. We don't know what the contents are, but it's a heavy box. It is never broken by any attack, but instead can be pushed left and right. Gollida and Kevin will die immediately if an iron box crushes them, so you should avoid it when you see a dropping iron box.

[b]2. Breakable Objects[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/a588b837d939fb21600f79fe792bbace1caee8b8.png[/img]
(1) Wood Box : We don't know why the Golida tribes use wood boxes, but they can be broken by hitting or dropping them. If you push it and drop it on enemies, the wood box will break and enemies hit by the wood box will be stunned for a while.
<Wood Box>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/4005fe8e2bbffe6a9e9f18b3e1b9a2ef0e78515a.png[/img]
(2) Empty energy box : A box with an empty energy section that can be broken by hitting or dropping it. Gollida and Kevin will die immediately if an empty energy box crushes them and the box will be broken, so you should avoid it when you see a dropping empty energy box.
<Empty energy box>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/efe8137e8443f0abd73ccf6de313c3d1c5c4d2f7.png[/img]
<Item box>
(3) Item box : Item boxes can be hit and broken and cannot be moved. Breaking item boxes will summon suit repair kits, special weapon refill kits, and an extra life item.
- Suit Repair Kit: Refills suit energy to 100%.
- Special Weapon Refill Kit: Refills the maximum number of suit special weapons.
- Extra Life: You can add 1 extra life to Kevin's base life. It doesn't come out well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/0005333d689a0ce8260ffa86454d53f0471a0af4.png[/img]
<Suit box>
(4) Suit box: Can be hit and destroyed and cannot be moved. When you destroy it, various suits item come out randomly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/9b1916a4ce9c404446e27de086c02f362d200e97.png[/img]
<Warp machine>
(5) Warp machine : There is a warp machine at the end of the stage. You can hit it to break it, but you can't move it. If you hit it, it gradually breaks, and when it is completely broken, a warp machine appears that allows you to move to the next stage or airship.


[b]3. Explodable objects[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/ec7a2e3990919bce326c6a0bf7af9507dbe5fece.png[/img]
<Energy Box>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/af80991622ca19326c2666ed0e283835c65a5e37.png[/img]
<Burning energy box>
- Energy Box : Energy Boxes will explode on impact (damage) by being hit or dropping down. The stronger the impact, the shorter the time it takes to explode. If you push it and drop it on the enemy, the basic Golidas will be crushed and die immediately, and the energy box will explode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/adc61ff1f8bd0de8357ad11661c829bdf781ce0e.png[/img]
<Drill Pod: Falls while rotating 90 degrees in the pushing direction>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/40687bc6c5a458692d744ffbd8712b6eb5a0f678.png[/img]
<Damaged drill pod: flies in the direction of the drill>
- Drill Pod : If you push a standing drill, it will rotate 90 degrees and fall over. If you hit or damage the energy body section below, it fires in the direction of the drill and explodes after a certain amount of time. The stronger the impact, the shorter the explosion time. If you touch the drill while wearing the suit, the suit will break at once, and if you do not have the suit, you will die at once. Be careful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/df9eb9d08342c1ef2b6a88cf88e731cfb75eed1d.png[/img]
<Air Mine>
- Air Mine : An electrified spiky aerial mine that is securely fastened to a chain. If you collide with a mine wearing a suit, you will take damage, and if you are Kevin, you will die immediately when you collide, so be careful when you look at the air mine. When the chain is broken, it rises like a balloon and explodes when it collides with a wall or after a certain amount of time.


[b]4. The rest objects[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/3627066958a02e63da5a5b3e65fc2f91cb2c042c.png[/img]
<Televator>
- Televator : An elevator made of electromagnetic fields. If you point your cursor upwards inside the televator, Kevin will automatically go up. To descend, simply press the cursor from the top of the televator to the bottom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/99b2031902f6cdd1d92a20702d8543c11c986bd0.png[/img]
<Ladder>
- Ladder : It's a very ordinary ladder that you can go down or up. There is a televator made by the Golida, but it is unknown why they even use a ladder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/6d2f235595179cd9370c9025cab2323b539db301.png[/img]
<Bridge>
- Bridge : This is a bridge that Kevin or the Golidas can stand on. It is indestructible and can be moved down by pressing the cursor down on the bridge. If the bottom is empty, you can die as is, so keep an eye on the bottom of your feet before going down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/d42aeb1813b4e8cc7f7c33fe85bad2eaf0002f04.png[/img]
<Save point>
- Save point : The save point is disabled by default, but is activated when Kevin passes. When Kevin dies, you start at the last active save point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/d71658c31f0493df4060d0b23ea260135d911589.png[/img]
<Iron door & Lever>
- Iron door & Lever: As you progress through the game, you will come to a place blocked by an iron door. Unfortunately, the iron door cannot be broken with any weapon. Instead, moving the lever near the iron door (melee attack) will open the iron door, so you should find the lever and open the door.

---------------------------------------

The mentioned objects are basic objects that you will always encounter as you progress through the game. There are special objects or puzzle elements for each chapter, but if you understand the basic objects well, you can use the objects to advance the game in an advantageous way.

In the next post, we will look at the worldview of Metal Suits and the background of Kevin's birth.

notes.title: METAL SUITS, Basic combat system and 5 basic Golida enemies
notes.content:
[b]1. Main character Kevin[/b]

As stated in the previous post, the main character ‘Kevin’ is not a human but a humanoid cyborg. Unlike ordinary soldiers, Kevin has a strong physical ability that never gets tired. He also can transform his body into various attack forms by getting suits item in game. A total of 5 types of suits have been developed at this moment, but the game is being developed with the goal of providing at least 10 types of suits at the time of release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/9675d1925ebf3e61f31c082a5a3b7c939486d19a.gif[/img]

From the left: Kevin, Bazooka suit, Gatling-gun suit, Machine gun suit, Fire suit, Fist suit

[previewyoutube=uOv1iX_k2zM;full][/previewyoutube]

Kevin can move up and down, left and right, and climb walls. In addition to basic movement, we are providing a total of 4 buttons including jump, basic attack, melee attack, and special attack. Even if you wear a suit, all functions work the same.

[previewyoutube=FbREUgds0CQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Despite possessing powerful attack power and an indefatigable cyborg body, Kevin is unfortunately as weak as a human. He will be killed with one hit, so be careful.

[previewyoutube=IfaNkYuJP9k;full][/previewyoutube]

Instead, if Kevin wears a variety of suits, each suit has energy, so even if he gets hit, he consumes suit energy and doesn’t die right away. However, if Kevin use up all the energy of suits, he will transform basic to Kevin, so you should check the remaining energy all the time. By the suits, please note that the basic attack method may change (press and hold, etc.) depending on the suit.

(1) Basic Attack

[previewyoutube=jBfCH0dduhg;full][/previewyoutube]

Kevin’s primary weapon is a laser pistol, which automatically reloads after 5 shots. Even if 5 shots are not used, it is automatically reloaded after a certain period of time so that the gameplay can be played smoothly.

(2) Melee Attack

[previewyoutube=sgRUTVXVilc;full][/previewyoutube]

Melee attacks have a short range, but are very powerful. It can also be used to kill enemies, destroy objects, or move the lever to open a closed door.

(3) Special Attack

[previewyoutube=wdQh4z1qDa4;full][/previewyoutube]

Kevin’s special attack is throwing grenades. Hold down the button to see the trajectory, and release the button to throw the grenade to that location. We are preparing various special attacks for each suit, so when introducing each suit, we will explain the special attack separately.


- - - - - - - - - - 


[b]2. Breakable Block[/b]

For unknown reasons, there are cracks in some of the buildings and ground blocks where the aliens invaded. Blocks with cracks will break when attacked. You can use it to perform a variety of tactics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/5351a7aa6d14c49011eb42d9989d4f49f03c6c4b.png[/img]
<Frontal attack>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/41db2066f195e2bb361ce698178cc654bac83c3d.png[/img]
<Sneak back attack>

There are various environments and various blocks for each chapter. Knowing which blocks break in each chapter will help you play the game to your advantage.


- - - - - - - - - - 


3. 5 basic Golida enemies

The Golida species are an alien race with one eye. No one knows where they came from, but in an instant, they invaded the Helios system and took over all the planets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/8921ad3b83b9698b3846cec31080ec10f1c3481c.png[/img]
<5 basic Golida enemies>

These are the 5 basic Golida enemies, I already introduced in the previous post, and you will see them the most in the game. From left to right: Golida with a laser pistol, Golida with a laser machine gun, Golida with a laser bazooka, Golida with a photon bomb, and Golida with a shield.

[previewyoutube=-cFzjAkraJI;full][/previewyoutube]
<Golida laser pistol>

[previewyoutube=582Usbeq2ck;full][/previewyoutube]
<Golida laser machine gun>

[previewyoutube=n3GSjIC93zg;full][/previewyoutube]
<Golida laser bazooka>

[previewyoutube=xh1h9T3VCRo;full][/previewyoutube]
<Golida photon bomb>

[previewyoutube=J5fGQfxffrI;full][/previewyoutube]
<Golida shield>

Basically, the Golidas have taken over all the planets in Hellios System, so everyone is loosening their wariness. If you attack quickly before enemies notice, you can take them all out before they attack. However, you need to be careful as the Golida that throws the photon bomb has a very wide field of view.


- - - - - - - - - - 


In today’s post, we tried explaining about the basic combat system and the five basic enemies of the Golida tribe. In the next post, I will explain various objects and devices that appear in the game.

Due to the end of the year, the next post will be posted in 4 weeks. Happy Holidays everyone, and Happy New Year!!

notes.title: METAL SUITS, Redesigning

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/2d782bf6b1e9efd798dd12dcbbc702ee40e85a4a.png[/img]

In fact, the reason why it had no choice but to do so is that, while developing for the first demo, we focused on developing the functional part rather than the design part. Because we needed a build that included character, monster, and map editor production, production and application of various in-game functions, production of various directing, and production of sound, we had to pay more attention to the functional part rather than the design identity or quality.

However, because of the strange(?) goal, we were able to show a demo version with the basic functions and 3 stages of the game in 3 months.

At the end of June 2022, a month after the first demo was shown, as a designer and 24-year-experienced game production PD (remunea) joins, Metal Suits begins to face a big change.

After the design of the main character, ‘Kevin’, was finalized, we also proceeded with the design of the enemies.

We chose the first one-eyed alien because we had to choose an enemy that wasn’t too famous, not too comical, not too eccentric, and not too familiar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/060d033096034929d45bc465fbfde3de332138ca.png[/img]

Each enemy has a variety of statuses, and when they find the main character, ‘Kevin’, they will attack him using their own weapons.

Tada~ The main title image was created based on the basic concept of the main character ‘Kevin’ and the enemy ‘Golida’.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/bfd142809ea87bf5316b508b27dce279807a0ef7.png[/img]

notes.title: METAL SUITS, the beginning
notes.content:
In February 2022, our team decided to develop a new game, not for mobile, it’s for Console and PC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/fc0feec79d2e0462e65cefd86a9f3e86917fa8d3.png[/img]

At that time, many friends, in the game industry, were worried about us because they thought that developing a Console / PC game needs more people and a budget. At that time, we were just 3 (Game designer, developer, and graphic designer) but we don’t care about it cause we just wanted to develop a really fun game, not a pay-to-win game or advertisement-based time-killing game.

To develop really fun games, I thought of pixel art games like Super Mario, Metal Slug, Ninja Turtles, Mega Man, and Another World. It’s a simple, old-style action and puzzle game, but it’s really fun to play with simple button controls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/7c1b70b9d84274341d2f77e295fae6afb5ee88fd.png[/img]
<Super Mario, Metal Slug, Mega Man, Ninja Turtle (clockwise from top-left)>

After that decision, I was preparing a scenario for a medieval knight, and at the same time, other members were preparing two different prototypes. One was a sword-fighting game and the other was a gun-fighting game.

After testing the two prototypes, we felt that the gun-fighting was much better than we thought, so we decided to develop a game with gun-fighting. After testing, we started developing the basics of a tile-based, side-scrolling action game, but since the art concept hadn’t been decided yet, we weren’t sure how ours would turn out.

So, we made several pixel arts for practice. These are the characters we practiced with. After practicing those characters, we had an idea for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/7003b5ae27344eb0138f280f4d7e215c3cecdebf.png[/img]
<24 * 24 pixels>

What if, a normal person can get a superpower like Iron Man? That would be awesome because, including me, almost people desire that’s gonna happen.

So we started to develop it. The concept of the game is that a normal person suits up and has a powerful weapon and special ability in various suits and fights against aliens. We designed each suit has unique weapons and special abilities so we called the game “METAL SUITS”.

After 3 months(end of May 2022), we developed the first playable prototype. This version contains only 2 suits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/05a97c6ff41388f9e85180380125797668303619.png[/img]
<Game screenshot>

[previewyoutube=kwnB4KZDHos;full][/previewyoutube]

In the first playable prototype, we added two types of blocks. One(dark gray) is breakable, and another one(light gray) cannot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790663/9dbe627d769f14f3f620962d314e81eefb34759e.png[/img]

In Broforce, my favorite game, users can destroy all the blocks, but it slows down the game. So we only added destructive blocks to some of them.

Utilizing the structure of the placed blocks, the user can decide how to fight the aliens. Depending on the user’s gameplay style, some users can kill aliens face-to-face by destroying the blocks, others can kill aliens silently like an assassin.

After the first playable version opens to friends, we got many feedbacks from friends. Next post, we will let you know what changed after the first playable build.
